acceptance: Pin source revision, file checksum, citation, provenance and redistribution terms.
Distinguish measured experimental data, fitted material properties, predictions and digitized curves.
Match material grade/composition, moisture, specimen geometry and apparatus; preserve units and uncertainty.
Validate an outcome-specific model against held-out experiments before deriving tolerable parameter intervals.
Do not silently mix external data with NASA records or expose internet tools to the model.
